run_evaluate_response_cli: run the evaluate_response CLI to compute BLEU scores between target and predicted response files
create_parse_response_from_file: create a call to parse_response_from_file that parses line-by-line responses with <SOR> and <EOS> delimiters
create_normalize_sentence: create a call to normalize_sentence that lowercases and tokenizes a sentence using nltk
test_parse_response_from_file: test parse_response_from_file with a file containing <SOR> context <EOS> delimited response lines
test_normalize_sentence: test normalize_sentence with a sample string and verify nltk word tokenization output
